sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and preserves all prior repair instructions; it is suitable to freeze for later RDF evaluation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair applicability and unit-safe comparison. Do not restrict every structural member to the invented exhaustive set {sideStructureLocation, bottomStructureLocation}; bottomStructureLocation is not a declared controlled value for this requirement, and longitudinal members at other locations must remain non-applicable rather than fail. Keep both applicability selectors mandatory for represented members, but structure the alternatives as: non-longitudinal; structuralLocation other than sideStructureLocation; or longitudinal plus sideStructureLocation with I2_034_ApplicableMemberShape. Also prevent unit-blind comparison: combinedShearAndBendingDemand currently has no required unit while its numeric value is compared directly with a kilonewton strength. Require unit evidence and make missing or unequal demand/strength units a violation before comparing numeric values; do not invent a fixed demand unit unsupported by its canonical metadata.

Restrict demand validation to applicable longitudinal side-frame members. The current StructuralMemberShape applies I2_034_LoadCaseShape to every represented structural member load case, so non-longitudinal members and members outside sideStructureLocation are incorrectly required to provide combinedShearAndBendingDemand. Move the hasStructuralMemberLoadCase property shape that invokes I2_034_LoadCaseShape into I2_034_ApplicableMemberShape, retaining no sh:minCount because the universal rule does not require load-case existence. Preserve the corrected applicability alternatives and the prior unit-presence, unit-agreement, tolerance, and comparison logic.

Enforce the supplied canonical object-property ranges: add sh:class nltl:structuralLocationValue to the structuralLocation property shape and sh:class nltl:frameProfileTypeValue to the ship-owned frameProfileType property shape. Mere sh:nodeKind sh:IRI does not verify the declared target-owner/range structure. Preserve the corrected applicability alternatives, applicable-member-only load-case validation, universal no-minCount behavior for members/load cases, unit presence and agreement, derived-result tolerance, and demand-versus-strength comparison.
Candidate is semantically faithful and preserves all prior repair instructions; it is suitable to freeze for later RDF evaluation.
